question: What ritual action must follow the consecration of the fire-pit fire?
premises: The consecration of the fire-pit fire is performed first
After that consecration a fire-offering is prescribed
The officiant should perform the fire-offering
inference: After consecrating the fire-pit fire, the officiant should perform the fire-offering
plain_english: After performing the consecration of the fire in the fire-pit, one should then perform the fire-offering.
